statements.sentence: Generate and check bcrypt hashes in your browser; pick $2b$, $2y$ or $2a$; see the 72-byte limit and which of PHP, Laravel, Node.js, Go or Spring accept it.
statements.qualification: Matches the three prefixes in the UI, the 72-byte warning and the measured library table.

statements.sentence: Cost ranges from 4 to 31 and defaults to 12; check the browser estimate.
statements.qualification: COSTS is 4..31, 12 is selected, and the estimate is measured in this browser.

statements.sentence: The counter shows characters and UTF-8 bytes and warns above bcrypt's 72-byte limit.
statements.qualification: checkPassword returns chars, bytes and an over72 issue; the meta line prints them.

statements.sentence: Example fills and checks a Spring Security value; parsing shows cleanup and format errors.
statements.qualification: The test drives the Example button and compares the result with the Spring reference {bcrypt} value.

statements.sentence: Read Match or No match and, where supported, copy the same hash with another prefix.
statements.qualification: prefixVariants returns the other two labels for $2a$, $2b$ and $2y$ only.

statements.sentence: Pick the prefix the verifying library writes; Laravel throws for $2a$/$2b$ unless HASH_VERIFY=false; Node.js bcrypt 6.0.0 returns false for $2y$; three prefixes are interchangeable for UTF-8 passwords under 256 bytes.
statements.qualification: Library claims match the fixture and sources. The 256-byte limit reflects OpenBSD's pre-$2b$ length bug; the tool's own fixture does not exercise it.

statements.sentence: bcrypt is one-way; checking re-hashes with the stored salt and cost; each hash has a 16-byte salt in characters 8-29.
statements.qualification: Layout is $2x$ + cost + 22-char salt + 31-char checksum; the salt encodes 16 bytes.

statements.sentence: bcrypt reads 72 bytes; most CJK characters are 3 bytes; Python bcrypt 5, Go and Spring Security 6.3+ refuse longer passwords; PHP, Node and bcryptjs truncate.
statements.qualification: Changed 'Chinese, Japanese and Korean characters' to 'most' (supplementary-plane kanji are 4 bytes) and Spring Security 6.3+ to 6.3.8 / 6.4.4 or later.

statements.sentence: Hashing runs in a Web Worker in the tab; no request carries the password or hash; nothing is saved; no analytics or ads load.
statements.qualification: persistence is 'disabled'; network.ts does not list the slug; the worker only importScripts /vendor/bcryptjs.min.js.

statements.sentence: Common causes are a hash cut off in copying (60 characters), $$ left from Docker Compose, a $2y$ hash checked by Node.js bcrypt, and non-zero padding bits.
statements.qualification: parseHash reports the 60-character length, $$ cleanup and non-canonical padding; Node's $2y$ result is in the fixture.

statements.sentence: OWASP asks for at least 10; PHP 8.4, Laravel and Python bcrypt default to 12; Node.js bcrypt, Go and Spring Security default to 10.
statements.qualification: Defaults are documented and recorded in the fixture.

statements.sentence: The Spring Security reference stores 'password' as {bcrypt}$2a$10$dXJ3SW6G7P50lGmMkkmwe.20cQQubK3.HZWzG3YB1tlRy.fqvM/BG; the Example button fills it in.
statements.qualification: The value is the documented example and the test verifies a match after stripping {bcrypt}.

statements.sentence: Laravel throws because HASH_VERIFY defaults to true and PHP password_get_info() names only $2y$ hashes 'bcrypt'.
statements.qualification: php-src registers only the 2y algorithm for password_get_info; Laravel 12 docs describe the algorithm check and HASH_VERIFY=false.

statements.sentence: The 72-byte limit.
The libraries split three ways: PHP, Node.js and bcryptjs truncate; Python bcrypt 5, Go and Spring Security 6.3 or later refuse; Symfony pre-hashes long passwords with SHA-512.
statements.qualification: Spring version corrected to 6.3.8 / 6.4.4 or later. Symfony also base64-encodes the SHA-512 digest before bcrypt; wording kept short but not false.

statements.sentence: Cost is a base-2 exponent (cost 12 = 4096 rounds); OWASP asks for at least 10; PHP 8.4, Laravel and Python default to 12; Node.js bcrypt, Go and Spring default to 10.
statements.qualification: PHP 8.4 changelog raises the default 10 to 12; Python gensalt defaults to 12; Go DefaultCost and Spring strength default to 10; node genSaltSync defaults to 10.

statements.sentence: OWASP recommends Argon2id (19 MiB, 2 iterations), then scrypt, and limits bcrypt to legacy systems; it gives bcrypt(base64(hmac-sha384(password, pepper))) and calls plain bcrypt(base64(sha512(password))) dangerous.
statements.qualification: Quotes match the cheat sheet; the HMAC construction is abbreviated from bcrypt(base64(hmac-sha384(data:$password, key:$pepper)), $salt, $cost).

statements.sentence: On 2026-10-02, bcrypt-generator.com, xyutil.com and 33tool.com wrote only $2a$, matched a 73-byte password against its first 72 bytes, and MiniWebtool POSTed the password.
statements.qualification: Dated observation; not re-run in this batch (no browser automation). Text left unchanged.

statements.sentence: The page uses bcryptjs 2.4.3; cost 31 is accepted but would take days in a browser.
statements.qualification: 2.4.3 is the vendored library per the fixture note and test. 'Days' is an estimate from the measured cost-12 time, not a timed cost-31 run.

statements.sentence: Only bcrypt is supported; Argon2, scrypt, SHA-crypt and phpass are recognized and named, not checked.
statements.qualification: detectOtherScheme covers argon2, scrypt, yescrypt, sha512crypt, sha256crypt, apr1, md5crypt, phpass, pbkdf2, ldap and hex digests.

statements.sentence: 在浏览器里生成和校验 bcrypt 哈希：可选 $2b$、$2y$、$2a$ 前缀与 4–31 的成本，提示 72 字节上限，并说明 PHP、Laravel、Node.js、Go、Spring 能否识别。
statements.qualification: Prefixes, cost range, 72-byte warning and the tested libraries match the UI and fixture.

statements.sentence: 输入“密码”，查看字符数和 UTF-8 字节数；超过 bcrypt 的 72 字节上限会显示警告。
statements.qualification: Matches checkPassword and the meta line.

statements.sentence: 计算在当前标签页的 Web Worker 里进行，页面不发送密码或哈希，也不保存；本页不加载统计和广告。
statements.qualification: persistence disabled; not in network.ts; no storage or fetch in the component.

statements.sentence: bcrypt 最多读密码的前 72 个字节。UTF-8 里一个汉字通常占 3 个字节，所以 24 个汉字就到上限。
statements.qualification: '通常' already limits the 3-byte rule; the example is exactly 72 bytes.

statements.sentence: PHP、Node.js bcrypt、bcryptjs 悄悄截断；Python bcrypt 5、Go、Spring Security 6.3 及以上直接报错（6.2.8 仍截断）。
statements.qualification: Spring Security corrected to 6.3.8 / 6.4.4 and later; 6.2.8 observation kept.

statements.sentence: 成本是 2 的指数，成本 12 做 4096 轮；OWASP 要求至少 10，并把 bcrypt 定为只想用于旧系统；新项目优先 Argon2id。
statements.qualification: Matches the OWASP cheat sheet and the bcrypt 2^cost definition.

statements.sentence: PHP、Laravel、Symfony 用 $2y$；Node.js 用 $2b$；Python 和 Go 三种都接受；Spring Security 默认 $2a$、三种都读；三种只在 256 字节以内可换前缀。
statements.qualification: Library claims match the fixture. The 256-byte condition is OpenBSD's pre-$2b$ length bug; not exercised by the fixture.

statements.sentence: bcrypt 是单向哈希；校验用哈希里的盐和成本重算；每次随机 16 字节盐，写在 8–29 字符。
statements.qualification: Matches the 22-character salt and 31-character checksum layout.

statements.sentence: bcrypt 只读 72 字节；汉字通常 3 字节，所以最多 24 个；Python bcrypt 5、Go、Spring 6.3+ 拒绝，PHP、Node、bcryptjs 截断。
statements.qualification: Added '通常' for 4-byte CJK and corrected the Spring Security boundary to 6.3.8 / 6.4.4; 'refuse' qualified to hashing.

statements.sentence: 常见原因：哈希被截断（固定 60 字符）、Docker Compose 留下的 $$、Node.js bcrypt 校验 $2y$、最后字符填充位非零。
statements.qualification: parseHash reports 60-character length, $$ cleanup, non-canonical padding; the $2y$ Node result is in the fixture.

statements.sentence: OWASP 要求至少 10；PHP 8.4、Laravel、Python 默认 12，Node.js bcrypt、Go、Spring Security 默认 10。
statements.qualification: Defaults are documented and recorded in the fixture.

statements.sentence: 若依用 Spring Security 的 BCryptPasswordEncoder 加密密码（SecurityUtils.encryptPassword）。
statements.qualification: Changed '加密密码' to '计算密码哈希'; the method name encryptPassword is RuoYi's, not evidence of reversible encryption.

statements.sentence: Bcrypt 在线加密与校验 | ZeroTool
statements.qualification: Not changed: seoTitle is preserved by task scope. bcrypt hashes; 加密 is inaccurate. Recommend replacing 加密 with 哈希.

statements.sentence: bcrypt のハッシュをブラウザーで生成・検証。$2b$・$2y$・$2a$ とコスト 4〜31、72 バイトの上限、Laravel・PHP・Node.js・Go・Spring の受け付けを表示。

statements.qualification: Example path and parser notes are test-covered.

statements.sentence: bcrypt は一方向。検証はハッシュ内のソルトとコストで再計算するだけ。16 バイトのソルトが 8〜29 文字目に入る。
statements.qualification: Matches the hash layout and the salt size.

statements.sentence: Spring Security 6.2.8 truncates, 6.3.10 throws in encode(), and long passwords still pass matches() after 6.3.
statements.qualification: 6.3.10 was not the first fixed release: 6.3.8 and 6.4.4 reject >72 bytes in encode (6.3.8 also in matches), while 6.5.11 matches by comparing the first 72 bytes. Text now says 6.3.8 / 6.4.4 and scopes the matches() behavior to 6.5.11.

statements.sentence: PHP·Laravel·Symfony는 $2y$, Node.js는 $2b$, Python·Go는 셋 다, Spring은 $2a$를 쓰고 셋 다 읽습니다. 256바이트 미만이면 접두사만 바꿔도 됩니다.

statements.sentence: 한글 음절은 3바이트라 24자까지. Python 5·Go·Spring 6.3 이상은 거부하고 PHP·Node·bcryptjs는 자릅니다.
statements.qualification: Spring Security boundary corrected to 6.3.8 / 6.4.4; the Hangul 3-byte claim is correct.

statements.qualification: All four are detected.

statements.sentence: Spring Security 7 and Symfony return false when they check an empty password.
statements.qualification: Spring Security 7's AbstractValidatingPasswordEncoder returns false for an empty raw password; Symfony's verify returns false for ''.

statements.sentence: PHP password_hash() refuses NUL and password_verify() stops reading at it; this page, Python, Node.js, Go and Spring include it.
statements.qualification: php-src raises for a NUL byte in bcrypt; the fixture records NUL handling for the other libraries.

statements.sentence: Changing the prefix between $2a$, $2b$ and $2y$ keeps the hash valid for UTF-8 passwords shorter than 256 bytes; all three run the same algorithm.
statements.qualification: Openwall states $2b$ behaves exactly as $2y$; the 256-byte boundary is OpenBSD's old length bug and is not exercised by the fixture.

statements.sentence: Python bcrypt raises Invalid salt; PHP, Node.js and Spring Security report a mismatch for a non-canonical salt.
statements.qualification: The fixture records exactly those results.

statements.sentence: $2x$ marks hashes from crypt_blowfish's old sign-extension bug; for all-ASCII passwords it equals $2a$ and is checked as $2a$.
statements.qualification: Openwall documents $2x$ as the buggy behavior and $2y$ as the corrected one; the tool's ASCII-only shortcut is in verifySalt.

statements.sentence: phpass ($P$ / $H$, WordPress before 6.8).
statements.qualification: No WordPress 6.8 primary source was fetched today; text left unchanged.
